## Symptom

`_metered_spend()` in `infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/handler.py` accumulates token spend across regions, but a single CloudWatch `ClientError` returns `None` from lines 316-318 or 329-331, discarding totals already collected from healthy regions.

## Code facts

`_metered_spend()` builds per-region CloudWatch queries at lines 283-315, prices token data into `total` at lines 332-337, returns `0.0` when no per-model series exists at lines 338-340, then returns `total` at line 341. The only production call site is `infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/handler.py:477`.

`handler()` uses the result in 4 places: the CE-poll trigger at line 493, unavailable handling at lines 507-514, display/log text at lines 523-540, the release guard at line 562, and the attach path at line 570. The CE-poll comment at lines 491-492 says a fresh authoritative read is required when the meter is close because stale CE is costly then.

Test references found: `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py:249` and `:254` monkeypatch `_metered_spend`; direct unit calls are at `:363`, `:390`, `:433`, `:889`, and `:919`.

## Design

Use a small result object, not a bare float: `MeteredSpend(total: float, degraded: bool, failures: tuple[MeteredFailure, ...])`, where each `MeteredFailure` stores `region` and `exception_class`. This is safer than `(total, degraded)` because line 493, line 562, log text, and tests all need the same degradation bit, while operators need the failed region details.

A degraded partial is a lower bound. It may trip the fail-closed attach path when `total >= THRESHOLD_USD`. It must not release a deny policy. It must not suppress CE polling at line 493. Implement the trigger as equivalent to `due or metered is None or metered.degraded or metered.total * 5 >= THRESHOLD_USD * 4` after adapting local variable names.

If at least 1 token series contributes before or after a regional `ClientError`, return `MeteredSpend(total=<partial>, degraded=True, failures=...)`. If no token series contributes and a CloudWatch `ClientError` prevents a complete scan, keep the unavailable path by returning `None`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/handler.py` defines `MeteredSpend`.
- [ ] `MeteredSpend.total` stores the numeric CloudWatch dollar total.
- [ ] `MeteredSpend.degraded` is `True` when at least 1 region raises `ClientError` during the scan.
- [ ] `MeteredSpend.failures` stores each failed region name.
- [ ] `MeteredSpend.failures` stores each failed exception class.
- [ ] `_metered_spend()` returns a degraded `MeteredSpend` after one region contributes token spend then a later region raises during `list_metrics`.
- [ ] `_metered_spend()` returns a degraded `MeteredSpend` after one region contributes token spend then a later region raises during `get_metric_data`.
- [ ] `_metered_spend()` continues scanning later regions after an earlier region raises `ClientError`.
- [ ] When a CloudWatch `ClientError` prevents a complete scan before any token series contributes, `_metered_spend()` returns `None`.
- [ ] Degraded-region logging includes the failed region name.
- [ ] Degraded-region logging includes the exception class name.
- [ ] For a degraded partial below the close threshold, the line 493 CE-poll trigger runs.
- [ ] The line 493 CE-poll trigger still runs when `MeteredSpend.total * 5 >= THRESHOLD_USD * 4`.
- [ ] `signal_unavailable` is `True` when `MeteredSpend.degraded` is `True`.
- [ ] A degraded partial with `total >= THRESHOLD_USD` attaches the deny policy when it is not attached.
- [ ] A degraded partial with `total < THRESHOLD_USD` leaves an existing deny policy attached.
- [ ] A degraded partial with `total < THRESHOLD_USD` publishes no release notification.
- [ ] Metered log text reports the numeric partial total when `MeteredSpend.degraded` is `True`.
- [ ] `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py::test_metered_spend_preserves_partial_total_when_later_region_listing_fails` covers the listing-failure partial.
- [ ] `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py::test_metered_spend_preserves_partial_total_when_later_region_data_fails` covers the data-failure partial.
- [ ] `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py::test_metered_spend_records_degraded_region_failure` covers region name logging.
- [ ] `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py::test_metered_spend_records_degraded_region_failure` covers exception class logging.
- [ ] `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py::test_degraded_partial_meter_triggers_ce_poll_when_below_close_threshold` covers the line 493 degraded CE poll.
- [ ] `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py::test_degraded_partial_meter_can_attach` covers fail-closed attachment.
- [ ] `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py::test_degraded_partial_meter_cannot_release` covers release blocking.
- [ ] `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py::test_metered_spend_cloudwatch_failure_before_any_series_reports_unavailable` covers the `None` fallback.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py` exits 0.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` exits 0.

## Testing

During development, run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py -k 'metered_spend or degraded_partial_meter'`. Before push, run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py`, then `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify`.

## Source

Raised from Gerrit change 2984 patchset 7 review feedback, then narrowed to preserve partial CloudWatch totals without weakening CE polling or release safety.
